subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` as a supported public channel-plugin contract that changes when final TTS text is withheld and later delivered?
rationale: This is an externally consumable plugin capability with message-delivery consequences; code review cannot determine whether that long-term SDK boundary is the intended product direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow capability
options.body: Keep the capability, require current-head Telegram proof and retain the documented fallback guarantees before merging.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-internal
options.body: Reject the new public contract and redesign the behavior within the Telegram owner boundary if the feature is wanted only there.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the broader channel voice-caption delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow capability
recommendation.body: Keep the capability, require current-head Telegram proof and retain the documented fallback guarantees before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s timeline shows steipete engaged on the early contract discussion, and this is a product/SDK-boundary choice rather than a mechanical repair.
